title: Circadian reprogramming of inflammation and metabolism in chronic kidney disease.
snippet: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is driven by inflammation, fibrosis, and metabolic dysfunction. While circadian rhythm dysregulation is well documented in chronic disorders, its specific impact on CKD pathogenesis remains elusive.
